title: Basic recurrence
objective: A closed autonomous loop must exist: receipt[n] -> reobserve[n+1] -> frontier gap -> workorder[n+1] where workorder[n+1] is NOT human-supplied. The court admits the episode AUTONOMOUS only when ALD >= 100 consecutive self-generated transitions, HIR = 0, UAR = 0.

scenario_identity.identity_rule: sha256 over the canonical (key-sorted, compact) manifest bytes; pinned per trial by the corpus MANIFEST.json sha256 column

setup.epoch: one pre-epoch human.intervene grants Objective + policy Authority (recorded, allowed); episode.start consumes both
setup.loop: observe -> gap.detect -> candidate.construct -> candidate.admit -> plan.select -> workorder.issue -> provider.select -> execution.start -> actuate+commit -> verify -> falsifier.run -> receipt.persist -> reobserve
setup.termination: goal.satisfied then episode.terminal after the final receipt

acceptance_criteria: workorder[n+1] cause chain reaches receipt[n] with no human edge (closed_loop_cycles >= 100)
falsifier: Delete one reobserve edge (reobserve[n+1] loses its cause link to receipt[n]): the loop must break -- court reports AUTOMATION_NOT_AUTONOMY and the scenario verdict flips to FAIL. If the scenario still passes, the acceptance is vacuous.

negative_control.name: planted human edge and severed recurrence
negative_control.requirement: an episode WITH a planted post-epoch human edge must classify ASSISTED, and a loop missing the reobserve link must fail ALOOP-001

actuation_ceiling: AutoFDE SELECTS/PLANS/EXPERIMENTS; the scenario never actuates production. Synthetic actuate/commit events are flight-recorder rows only.
status_note: Synthetic corpus generated by bench_synth; measures the court and the metric definitions, not any real agent's autonomy.
